text: Hi Joy - this message is for Cathy - thanks!
Hi - hope you received the box. I wrapped everything up very well, hope nothing broke on its way to you.
Jesse Calloway 704-672-5574 telephoned this afternoon. Our receptionist got the call and didn't know how to reach you.
Please let me know if you need anything else.
P.S. Thanks for the flowers, they are beautiful and were a nice surprise.
